About Lexitas
Lexitas is a high growth company. The Company is built on a belief that having strong personal relationships with our clients, and providing reliable, accurate and professional services is the driving force of our success.
Lexitas offers an array of services including local and national court reporting, medical record retrieval, process service, registered agent services and legal talent outsourcing. Our reach is truly national as well as international.
Lexitas is a MNC Company that has set up a subsidiary in Chennai, India – Lexitas India Pvt. Ltd. This Indian company will be the Lexitas Global Capability Center, helping build a world class IT development team, and over time serve as a Shared Services hub for several of the corporate functions.

This is a Full-Time Job located in Chennai, India

Responsibilities
• Work with a team to provide end to end solutions including coding, unit testing and defect fixes.
• Work to build scalable solutions and work with quality assurance and control teams to analyze and fix issues
• Develop and maintain APIs and Services in C# .NET
• Develop and maintain web-based UI’s using front-end frameworks
• Conduct code reviews, unit testing and integration testing
• Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from concept and design to implementation and support.
• Provide technical support and guidance to other team members and stakeholders.
• Ensure application performance, scalability, and security through best practices in coding, testing and deployment
• Collaborate with DevOps team for troubleshooting deployment issues.

Qualification
• A bachelor's degree in computer science or a Masters preferred
• Strong direct experience in Object Oriented programming using C#.
• 8+ years of direct experience with C# and the .NET (.NET 8+ preferred)
• 5+ years of experience with front-end frameworks using React
• Good direct experience working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery
• 5+ year of experience working on any SQL database (MySQL/MS SQL/Postgre SQL)
• 5+ years of experience in designing and architecting complex software systems
• Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
• Microservices architecture and containerization.
• Expertise in performance monitoring, tuning, and optimization
• Understanding of DevOps practices for automated deployments.
• Understanding of software design patterns and best practices.
• Practical experience working in Agile developments (scrum) with exposure to JIRA
• Excellent critical thinking skills and the ability to mentor junior team members.
• Effectively communicate and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

For More Information about the company - https://www.lexitaslegal.com/

314afab0aaf1ee46.description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
About the Role
We’re hiring Field Engineers focused on Healthcare to partner with prospective and strategic enterprise customers. As a Field Engineer, you’ll be the technical face of Anysphere in the field, helping customers evaluate Cursor, guiding them through proofs of concept, and ensuring they see the full value of AI in their engineering workflows.
You’ll work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor to technical stakeholders. This is a highly customer-facing role where you’ll combine deep technical fluency with strong communication skills to drive adoption and influence product direction.

What you’ll do
• 
Partner with AEs to own technical discovery, demos, POCs, and technical validation for new deals and expansion
• 
Build trusted relationships across engineering, security, product and IT stakeholders
• 
Go deep in mission-critical and high-security environments: developer workflows, AI tooling, complex / constrained setups
• 
Help customers connect Cursor to outcomes that matter: developer productivity, secure software delivery, and mission velocity
• 
Deliver technical presentations, whiteboards, and workshops for technical and executive audiences
• 
Act as the customer's technical advocate internally with Product and Engineering
• 
Partner with post-sales to hand off cleanly and set up onboarding for success
You may be a fit if
• 
You have strong communication skills and executive presence, equally comfortable developing alongside engineers or presenting to CTOs, CISOs, and program leaders
• 
You understand the SDLC and can connect technical detail to mission and operational impact
• 
You have hands-on technical fluency (not full-time eng): workflows, AI tooling, complex / constrained environments
• 
You have deal-partner strategic instincts: co-own with AEs and navigate complex, multi-threaded stakeholder maps
• 
You have experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales, or Consulting, ideally in federal, defense, or highly regulated tech
• 
You're excited by Healthcare and comfortable learning buying motions, security expectations, and partner ecosystems fast

318889eedeaf8ef7.description:
As a Senior Full Stack Engineer at Sphere, you will play a critical role in building and scaling our risk intelligence platform. You will work across the full technology stack to implement core product features, improve system performance, and contribute to architectural decisions that shape the future of the platform.

This is a hybrid role located in Gurgaon therefore applicants are required to be located in Gurgaon / commutable distance to Gurgaon. 

a) Full-Stack Development
• Develop, test, and maintain robust, scalable, and efficient code across backend (Python/Django), frontend (React/Next.js), and database (PostgreSQL, Redis).
• Translate product and UX designs into functional user interfaces and responsive web applications.
• Build and maintain API endpoints for integration with AI/ML models, third-party data sources, and internal services.
• Tracking progress and deploying the code using GitHub, Docker and AWS.

b) System Architecture & Design
• Work closely with the CTO to design and implement modular, secure, and high-performance systems.
• Participate in architectural planning for microservices, caching layers, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tools.
• Contribute to platform-wide initiatives such as scalability, security hardening, and fault-tolerant systems.

c) Quality, Testing & Delivery
• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code with appropriate test coverage.
• Lead or contribute to code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization.
• Champion engineering best practices, including automated testing, CI/CD workflows, and documentation standards.

d) Technical Ownership & Mentorship
• Take end-to-end ownership of assigned platform modules (e.g., Admin UI, inspection dashboards, control scoring engine) from architecture to deployment.
• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to code reviews, design reviews, and engineering efforts.
• Collaborate with QA and DevOps to ensure robust, tested releases.

e) Cross-functional Collaboration
• Work closely with product managers, designers, data scientists, and external partners to ensure timely and high-quality feature delivery.
• Collaborate with the AI/ML team to integrate intelligent scoring models and geo-spatial data feeds into the platform.

f) Innovation & Continuous Learning
• Explore and evaluate new technologies (e.g., containerization, serverless design, or AI integrations) to improve platform scalability and performance

 Preferred Qualifications and Experience: 
• Total professional experience between 5 to 10 years, with minimum 2 years of experience in Django and 2 years of ReactJS is must 
• Hands on experience in the following technologies – Django, DRF, ReactJS, NextJS, Tailwind CSS, HTML, CSS, JS 
• Strong understanding of OOPs concepts 
• Proficient in using the core features of Django  
• Experience in databases (Postgres/MySQL/Redis) 
• Familiar with Docker, GitHub, CI/CD, AWS, DevOps
• Previous experience of banking applications is an additional benefit 
• Understanding of REST APIs and web security best practices 
• Experience in Geospatial data will be a plus
• Experience in AI Model Integrations will be a plus 
• Basic understanding of Testing frameworks.
